description: This file is a PHP class defining an admin controller for the Product Viewed report in an OpenCart extension. It handles rendering the report form, saving configuration, installing/uninstalling the report extension, and generating/viewing product viewing statistics with pagination.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for managing the product viewed report in the admin panel, including display, configuration, and data retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the report configuration form page with breadcrumb navigation and report status settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration parameters via POST request, with permission check.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the report extension by calling the relevant model method, permission-restricted.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the report extension by calling the relevant model method, permission-restricted.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the product viewed report with data prepared by getReport().

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the product viewed report data, primarily for AJAX or internal calls.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares product view statistics data with pagination, used for report display.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to generate or refresh report data, with permission check.
